question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS std_dev_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
items AS (
  SELECT "loss_rate_%",
    s.avg_loss_rate,
    s.std_dev_loss_rate,
    s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_dev_loss_rate AS lower_bound,
    s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_dev_loss_rate AS upper_bound
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df, stats s
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(ANY_VALUE(avg_loss_rate), 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" < lower_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_1_std_dev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" >= lower_bound AND "loss_rate_%" <= upper_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_1_std_dev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" > upper_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_1_std_dev
FROM items
